messages:
Zoe (People Ops): quick heads-up: deadline + contingency thread. were locking submissions NA 03/31 23:59 PT, EMEA 04/02 23:59 CET. I need a volunteer to cover the Wed afternoon calibration if someone needs last-minute swaps.
Ravi (Eng Manager): I can trade Wed 15:00 if someone covers my Mon morning slot.
Lina (Manager): Im on PTO Mon morning, so i'll take Wed 15:00. updated the public doc.
Zoe (People Ops): thanks Lina : I've updated the calendar and added "delegate: Lina" to the owner field. Reminder: delegates must accept invites and will be recorded as approver if they issue exception codes.
Ken (SRE): quick note: some calibrations overlap with on-call. can people tag "on-call-safe"? last cycle we had paging during a session.
Zoe (People Ops): yes : added an "on-call-safe" column to the tracker. if a slot is not safe, please mark it and we'll offer a backup slot next business day.
Lina (Manager): question on evidence intake: one of my reports has a 200MB recording. forms times out on large uploads. preferred intake?
Zoe (People Ops): preferred: upload to internal drive, paste link in reviewer comments with access set to company. alternate: email people-ops@redwood with subject "REVIEW-EVIDENCE + <employee>" and include manager note + file metadata. well ingest manually.
forms-bot: Reminder: submission windows and fallback intake posted in tracker. Late exceptions require manager note + approval code.
Ravi (Eng Manager): small ops ask : can the invites include a per-case timebox? helps calibrators stay on schedule.
Zoe (People Ops): yes : adding a 4-min default per case to invites and a 1-line rubric checklist.
Ken (SRE): last ask : please mute hiring digests during primary calibration hours to reduce noise for reviewers.
Zoe (People Ops): doing that now. final ops checklist for managers: 1) confirm delegate on invite 2) add drive links or prepare email fallback 3) follow 3-5 min timebox per case 4) mark on-call-safe where needed. ping me for emergency approval codes. :white_check_mark:
